state.summary: Order 88213 was placed on 2 March for a standing desk (oak, 160 cm) and a monitor arm. The desk arrived on 9 March with a cracked top panel; the monitor arm has not arrived. I contacted chat support on 10 March and was told a replacement panel would ship within 5 business days. It is now 24 March and I have received neither the panel nor a tracking number. I have paid in full ($1,245.00 including delivery). I would like either a replacement desk top shipped this week with tracking, or a partial refund of $300 for the damage.
